content: { "rules": [ "Correct for over-optimism in early forecast periods — especially after sentiment spikes — by reducing initial forecast values by 2–5% if sentiment was >0.20 in prior 3 days.", "Apply mean reversion bias correction: if forecast exceeds 3σ above recent 10-day average, reduce by 1–3% per day until convergence.", "After a sharp price spike (forecast > +3% from prior day), reduce forecast by 1–2% for next 3 days to account for momentum decay.", "If sentiment remains flat (0.00 for 5+ days), reduce forecast slope by 0.5–1.0% per day to avoid overconfidence in continuation.", "For 30-day horizon, cap forecast at 10% below 30-day moving average of true values if sentiment is neutral or negative." ] }
